column3: \t\t支援状態．美樹　が消された後のターン
column4: Support state. Turn after Miki has been erased.

column3: \t\t後ろを見て、きょろきょろ、美樹ちゃんが居ない、どこにいった・・
column4: Looking back and around anxiously, Miki-chan is gone. Where did she go...

column3: \t\tまさか、お前達・・美樹ちゃんに手を出したな。
column4: No way, you guys... you laid a hand on Miki-chan.

column3: \t\tがはははは、邪魔だから少し
column4: Gahahahaha, she was a nuisance, so just a little...

column3: \t\tきさまー美樹ちゃんを殺したのかー
column4: You bastard - did you kill Miki-chan?

column3: \t\tいや、魔王殺すなんて無理だから、そんな事はしないぞ
column4: No, killing the Demon King is impossible, so we wouldn't do something like that.

column3: \t\tおのれー　健太郎、聞いてない
column4: Damn you - Kentarou didn't hear any of that.
